name: Memories Off: Yubikiri no Kioku
original_name: メモリーズオフ ゆびきりの記憶
source:
The player takes on the role of Naoki Serizawa, the protagonist of Yubikiri no Kioku. Naoki used to live at Chinatsu's home but is now living alone. Naoki is a second year student at the private Tourin high school. Chinatsu Amakawa is also a second year student at the private Tohrin high school and is a classmate of Naoki's. As Chinatsu is concerned about Naoki at all times, she commutes to school with him and is always around him during school hours. Kasumi Nagumo is a runaway girl who suddenly arrived at the doorsteps of Naoki's place and is forcibly living with him at the moment. Orihime Hoshitsuki is the new math teacher for Naoki's class at Tourin high school. Lisa Caycy Foster is an American girl who has gone to Japan to study abroad temporarily. Lisa works part-time at a restaurant called Fuuruuyan and is where he meets Naoki. Lisa's reason for studying in Japan is because of her interest in Japanese history and culture. Shiina Kodou is a first year student at Tourin high school. She is very outgoing and loves gossips.

(edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off:_Yubikiri_no_Kioku]Wikipedia[/url])
translation:
玩家将扮演《勾指起誓的记忆》的主人公芹泽直树。直树过去住在千夏家中，如今独自生活，是私立藤林高中二年级学生。天川千夏同样就读藤林高中二年级，也是直树的同班同学。千夏始终挂念直树，因此和他一起上下学，在校期间也总陪在他身边。南云霞是一名离家出走的少女，突然来到直树家门口，目前强行与他同住。星月织姬是藤林高中直树班上新来的数学教师。莉莎·凯西·福斯特是一名暂时前往日本留学的美国女孩，在名为“风流庵”的餐厅兼职，并在那里认识直树。莉莎来到日本留学，是因为对日本历史和文化感兴趣。鼓堂诗名是藤林高中一年级学生，性格非常外向，喜欢各种传闻。

[编辑自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off:_Yubikiri_no_Kioku]Wikipedia[/url]]
